title: Enforcement, Crisis Management and Emerging Risks
summary: Using MiCA's graduated enforcement toolkit, managing a CASP in distress through to orderly wind-down, and anticipating emerging risks in digital finance, ending with a capstone crisis simulation.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Using MiCA's graduated enforcement toolkit, managing a CASP in distress through to orderly wind-down, and anticipating emerging risks in digital finance, ending with a capstone crisis simulation.
Learning Objectives: Apply MiCA's supervisory measures and penalties proportionately and with sound process
Manage a CASP crisis from early distress to orderly wind-down and cross-border coordination
Assess emerging risks and their implications for supervisory strategy and capability
Syllabus: From supervisory measures to fines, public warnings and withdrawal of authorisation
Lessons from major crypto exchange and crypto lender failures
Emerging risks: DeFi, tokenised infrastructure, AI-driven trading and the digital euro
Intended Audience: Authorisation, supervision and inspection staff responsible for crypto-asset service providers and token issuers
AML/CFT, market integrity, ICT risk and enforcement specialists covering digital finance
Heads of department and senior managers setting the authority's crypto-asset supervisory strategy
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of authorising or supervising financial firms is helpful. No technical background in blockchain is required, as the first pathway builds the foundations.
Core Reading: Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 on information accompanying transfers of funds and certain crypto-assets (Transfer of Funds Regulation)
Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 on digital operational resilience for the financial sector (DORA)
FSB, High-level Recommendations for the Regulation, Supervision and Oversight of Crypto-Asset Activities and Markets (2023)
